name: Zacatecas
description: Semi-arid highland basins on the northern Mesoamerican frontier; volcanic geology with rhyolitic and andesitic outcrops.

name: Oaxaca
description: Highland valley system with metamorphic and alluvial clay sources; long ceramic sequence centred on Monte Albán.

name: State of Mexico
description: High-altitude lacustrine basin; volcanic ash and pumice-rich clays used throughout the Classic period.

name: Yucatán
description: Karstic limestone plain; calcareous clays and palygorskite temper characterise the regional slate wares.

name: Petén
description: Tropical lowland karst with dense Classic-period settlement; calcite-tempered fabrics dominate.

name: Copán
description: River valley on the southeastern Maya frontier; volcanic ash tempers common in fine serving wares.

name: Ancash
description: Coastal desert valleys backed by the Cordillera Negra; granodioritic and quartz-rich sands.

name: Coclé
description: Pacific-slope river plains; fine iron-rich clays supporting the central Panamanian polychrome tradition.

name: Phoenix Basin
description: Lower Salt and middle Gila river valleys; Hohokam canal irrigation communities on alluvial fans with schist and phyllite sources in the flanking ranges.
